snippet.title: BOSS CENTEMPEST and Repair Unit   MorTown
snippet.description:
New boss: CENTEMEST
After losing half HP it activates 5 healing eggs, each has 10000 HP points, and after destroying one egg, it has a 30% chance to drop a new item "Healing Core", which can be used to craft a "Repair Unit", a new placeable structure that repairs nearby structures.
also theres a new mele item that can be crafted: "Chainsaw"!!

Also join our discord server if you would like to share some ideas!!
https://discord.gg/HfupRmgJCr
and stay tuned for future updates :)

(the lag in the video is due to obs, sorry about that)
